items: 600–750g / 1.2–1.5 lb chicken breasts (4 pieces) (or boneless thigh)
1 tbsp fish sauce or 2 tbsp soy sauce

steps: Pound chicken: Use your fist (or a rolling pin) to pound the fat end of each chicken breast to about 1.7 cm / 2/3" thickness. (Not required for thigh.)
Marinate: Place chicken and marinade ingredients in a ziplock bag. Massage to distribute evenly, place on a plate/bowl, and refrigerate 24 hours (min 12 hrs, max 48 hrs).

Cook: Remove chicken and discard marinade. Cook using one method below (internal temp 165F/75C): Stove: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook 3 minutes per side until caramelised and golden. BBQ: Brush grills with oil and heat to medium-high. Cook 3 minutes per side until caramelised. Oven: Preheat to 425F/220C. Bake 15 minutes, then broil/grill on high for 3 minutes to caramelise.
Rest & serve: Transfer to plate, cover loosely with foil, rest 3 minutes. Garnish with extra cilantro/coriander, lime wedges, and chilli if desired, then serve.
